notes: Both publisher full-text titles verified against supplied references; publisher PDF pages confirm the supplied p. 5 original and p. 4 replication locators. Original η² and p refer to the same omnibus MANOVA, including control measures; replication η² and p refer to the same reliability-change ANOVA. Exact analytic n left null on both sides rather than infer from df or use a generic total. Replication printed sample counts conflict (abstract 196, recruited 197, condition counts 96 and 102); no exclusion accounting resolves this in the article.
